correctness.rationale: Exact cardinal EF1 reduction for the (2,1,1) allocation shape; every strict profile is represented by the first-agent-normalized 24^5 possible six-agent strict rankings, and 36 balanced allocations are all enumerated with complete integer bitsets. The full certificate reports h_2=6912 and no h_0/h_1, proves the full 17-row law and a minimum of two. Tie breaking weakly preserves cardinal inequalities. Literal 36-allocation and 243-allocation independent checks verify the sharpness profiles and the cited five-good obstruction; analytic mean 64/9 crosschecks the histogram. None of this is a non-exhaustive sample. Proof and two sources were replayed.

value.rationale: The 2025 five-good fixed-three-couple impossibility motivates the adjacent four-good existence boundary. The new exact minimum, sharp example and complete frequency law answer the natural smallest-obstruction and multiplicity questions, and show exactly how rare the most constrained instances are (1/1152 of strict profiles). These assertions are not standard EF1 deductions, nor known-table recomputations in the material inspected. The classification has explicit finite applicability and does not claim larger-group or variable-good results.
